slice: Bound free-text public metadata before stage descriptor publication.
finding: Recursive forbidden-key checks do not prevent private, credential-like, contact, or commerce material from being embedded inside otherwise permitted string values.

controls: control-character rejection except tab, line feed, and carriage return

verification.method: isolated Node test execution against the committed implementation and test fixtures

limits: Pattern rejection is bounded and cannot prove semantic privacy for all natural-language strings.
No browser, deployment, or physical-device behavior was exercised.
The descriptor remains operations-only and default-off.
falsification_routes: Provide a disallowed string that bypasses every current rule.
Demonstrate a permitted public phrase that is incorrectly rejected.
Run the repository-native test suite and compare results with the isolated execution.
